thought.text: The full stack is up and seeded. Now let me start the dev servers (`just serve`) in the background, then verify end-to-end.

reasoning_content:
Excellent! `just up --detach` completed:
- Preflight OK
- Backend image built
- Infrastructure (postgres, keycloak, meilisearch, localstack, mailpit, imgproxy, sendinblue, sample-images) all up and healthy
- Backend (spring-app) healthy
- Sample data seeded successfully (exit code 0)
- URLs printed
- Postgres available at localhost:32768

Now the dev servers are not started (because --detach). The `up.mjs` process is still running — wait, that's odd. Let me check. Actually `pgrep -f up.mjs` said RUNNING but the output shows "Dev servers not started (--detach). Run `just serve` to start them." which is the final line of main() for the detach path, which returns 0. So the process should have exited. Let me re-check. Maybe pgrep matched the nohup shell or something. Let me verify.

Actually the process likely finished. Let me start the dev servers with `just serve` and then verify the whole thing works end-to-end (backend health, frontend, login).

Let me start `just serve` in the background.

action.command:
cd /workspace && export GITHUB_TOKEN="urbo-dev-token-not-consumed-by-build" && nohup just serve > /tmp/just-serve.log 2>&1 &
echo "just serve pid $!"; sleep 30; tail -20 /tmp/just-serve.log
